events.text: In the middle of an ordinary evening the lamp flame stands straight up, and the roof is suddenly not there. A road of white light comes down out of the sky and stops at the threshold, waiting for {npc}. {He} has reached Divine Transcendence. {He} looks at the light, and then at you, and does not move.

choices.text: Tell {him} to go, and that you will follow

mem.note: promised to follow me up the stairs

effects.log: You walk {npc} to the first step. "Go," you say. "I will follow." {He} holds your face in both hands, and then {he} is climbing, and then {he} is light.

choices.text: Hold on to {him} for one more night

mem.note: held me one more night before the stairs

effects.log: The road of light waits until dawn, as if it understood. In the morning {npc} goes up it with the sun, looking back the whole way.

choices.text: Give {him} something of yours to carry up

mem.note: gave me something to carry into the sky

effects.log: You press your oldest keepsake into {his} hand. {npc} closes {his} fingers around it and climbs. Somewhere above the clouds it will be waiting with {him}.

events.text: You taught {npc} to stand in a horse stance when {he} was too small to reach the table. Now {he} stands in the courtyard of the house you raised {him} in, and the sky has opened over {him}: a white road down to the old plum tree, and the whole household at the windows. Divine Transcendence. Your child is going first.

choices.text: Tell {him} you are proud of {him}

mem.note: was told I made them proud when the sky opened

effects.log: You say it plainly, the way you never quite did when {he} was small. {npc} laughs, wipes {his} eyes, and climbs the white stairs looking back at you.

choices.text: Walk {him} to the first step, as on {his} first day of training

mem.note: was walked to the first step of the stairs

effects.log: You walk {npc} to the foot of the road as you once walked {him} to {his} first lesson. At the first step {he} lets go of your hand by {him}self, and goes.

choices.text: Tell {him} to keep a room ready for you above

mem.note: is to keep a room ready above the clouds

effects.log: "A room with a window," you say. "And somewhere to train." {npc} promises, very seriously, and goes up the stairs two at a time.

events.text: The family shrine has never been so quiet. {npc} kneels before the tablets of the ancestors with incense in both hands, and above the roof the clouds part for {him}: Divine Transcendence. {He} finishes the bows before {he} stands. "Someone of this house has to go first," {he} says. "It may as well be me."

choices.text: Kneel beside {him} for the last bow

mem.note: knelt beside me for the last bow

effects.log: You make the last bow together. Then {npc} goes out under the open sky, and the house watches the light take {him} up.

choices.text: Give {him} the family name to carry up

mem.note: carried the family name into the sky

effects.log: "Carry the name up with you," you say. "Let them learn it there before I come." {npc} bows once more, and climbs.

events.text: Your disciple {npc} comes out of seclusion and the sky follows {him} out: a white road from the clouds to the training yard, and every bird on the mountain silent. Divine Transcendence. The student you taught to hold a sword is going where you have not yet gone.

choices.text: Bow to {npc} as the student who went first

mem.note: bowed to me when the sky opened

effects.log: You bow first. {npc} stares, then bows lower, and goes up the white road with tears on {his} face. The whole sect saw it.

choices.text: Give {him} the last lesson you have

mem.note: gave me one last lesson at the foot of the stairs

effects.log: You give {npc} the last thing you know that {he} does not. {He} listens as {he} did at nine years old, then climbs.

choices.text: Tell {him} to keep a hall ready for you

mem.note: is to keep a hall ready above the clouds

effects.log: "Keep a hall ready," you say. {npc} laughs and promises, and goes up the stairs two at a time.

events.text: Your master {npc} sends for you at dawn. In the courtyard the sky has opened: a white road down to the old stone where {he} used to sit and watch you train. Divine Transcendence, after all these years. "I wanted you to see it," {npc} says. "So you know it can be done."

choices.text: Kneel and thank {npc} for every year

mem.note: knelt to me at the foot of the stairs

effects.log: {npc} pulls you up by both hands. "Never kneel to me," {he} says. "Climb." And then {he} does.

choices.text: Ask {him} what is up there

mem.note: asked me what waits above

effects.log: "I do not know," {npc} says, delighted. "Is that not wonderful?" {He} goes up the stairs like a young disciple on the first day.

choices.text: Promise to catch up

mem.note: promised to catch up with me above

effects.log: "I will hold you to that," {npc} says from the third step. "I will be counting the years."

events.text: The whole murim hears it at once: a crack like a bell the size of a mountain, and a white road from the clouds down to where {npc} stands. Your rival reached Divine Transcendence first. Before {he} sets foot on the stairs, {he} turns and finds you in the crowd as if there were nobody else there.

choices.text: Shout that you will catch {him}

mem.note: swore to chase me into the sky

effects.log: "Wait for me up there!" you shout. {npc} grins the old grin. "Hurry, then." And {he} goes, and the race goes on above the clouds.

choices.text: Bow, one martial artist to another

mem.note: bowed when the sky opened for me

effects.log: {npc} returns the bow exactly. Neither of you says it, but you both know the next exchange will be fought above the clouds.

choices.text: Turn your back and go to train

effects.log: You do not watch {npc} go. You are already in the training yard before the light fades, and you do not stop until it is dark.

events.text: Word comes on every road at once: {npc}, one of the great names of the murim, has reached Divine Transcendence. You are close enough to see it: the white road out of the clouds, and {npc} standing at the foot of it, looking back over the whole world {he} is leaving.

choices.text: Watch until the light is gone

effects.log: You watch {npc} climb until there is nothing left but sky. The road above the clouds is real. Somebody just walked it.

choices.text: Call out a farewell

mem.note: called a farewell when the sky opened for me

effects.log: Your voice carries. {npc} turns on the stairs and raises a hand to you, a stranger who called out, and then {he} is gone.

events.text: At the top of the white stairs, among the floating isles, someone is sitting on the jade steps as if they had been sitting there a long time: {npc}. {He} stands up slowly. "You took your time," {he} says, and {his} voice breaks on the last word.

choices.text: Run the last steps

mem.note: ran up the last steps to me

effects.log: You run the last steps. {npc} catches you, and for a long while neither of you has anything to say at all.

choices.text: Ask {him} to show you the Upper Realm

mem.note: let me show them the sky

effects.log: {npc} takes your hand and shows you everything: the isles, the jade pavilions, the place {he} sat every evening watching the stairs.

choices.text: Give back the promise you made

mem.note: kept the promise to follow

effects.log: "I said I would follow," you say. "I did." {npc} laughs and cries at once, and the immortals nearby politely look at the clouds.

events.text: At the top of the white stairs someone is pacing up and down the jade steps the way {he} used to pace the courtyard before an exam: {npc}, your child, an immortal now, and still yours. {He} sees you and stops dead. "I kept a room for you," {he} says. "It has a window. You always liked a window."

choices.text: Hold {him} as you did when {he} was small

mem.note: was held at the top of the stairs

effects.log: {npc} is taller than you remember, and an immortal, and it makes no difference at all. You hold on for a long time.

choices.text: Ask {him} to show you the room

mem.note: showed me the room kept above the clouds

effects.log: {npc} shows you the room, and its window, and the training yard, and everyone {he} has told about you. It turns out to be most of the Upper Realm.

choices.text: Look at what {he} has become, and tell {him}

mem.note: saw what I had become above

effects.log: You tell {npc} exactly what you see: someone who went further than you dared hope. {He} has to look away at the clouds for a while.

events.text: Among the floating isles a house stands that looks exactly like the one below: the same gate, the same plum tree, built from cloud-jade by {npc}, your child, so that you would know it when you came. {He} opens the gate before you knock. "Welcome home," {he} says.

choices.text: Walk in and sit under the plum tree

mem.note: sat under the plum tree in the house above

effects.log: You sit under the cloud-jade plum tree with {npc}, and for an evening it is the old courtyard again, with the whole sky for a roof.

choices.text: Ask {him} how long {he} waited

mem.note: was asked how long I waited

effects.log: "Not long," {npc} says, which is plainly untrue. {He} has kept every year of it in a book by the gate.

events.text: Your disciple {npc} is waiting above the clouds, older in the eyes and dressed like an immortal, and still bows the way you taught {him} at nine years old: too low, and too long. "Master," {he} says. "I kept a place for you."

choices.text: Raise {him} up and look at what {he} has become

mem.note: saw what I had become above

effects.log: You raise {npc} up. {He} has grown strong up here, stronger than you knew. It is the best thing you have seen in years.

choices.text: Ask {him} to help you find your feet

mem.note: asked me to show them the Upper Realm

effects.log: For once the student leads the master. {npc} shows you which isles are safe and which immortals to avoid, very seriously, and you let {him}.

events.text: An immortal in plain robes is waiting at the top of the white stairs, and the others make way for {him}: {npc}, your old master, a senior up here, as {he} was below. "I counted the years," {npc} says. "I knew you would come."

choices.text: Bow as {his} student, as on the first day

mem.note: bowed to me as on the first day

effects.log: {npc} returns the bow, and then cuffs the back of your head, as {he} used to. "Never mind bowing. Come and meet everyone."

choices.text: Ask {him} to teach you the ways of this realm

mem.note: asked to be taught again above

effects.log: "A student again," {npc} says, very pleased. "Good. You have a great deal to learn." {He} is right.

events.text: You have not taken ten steps into the Upper Realm before you feel it: a pressure you know as well as your own heartbeat. {npc} is leaning on a jade pillar, a realm above you, exactly as you expected. "So," your rival says. "The race goes on."

choices.text: Challenge {him} on the spot

mem.note: was challenged the moment they arrived

effects.log: You fight until the clouds around you are in tatters. {npc} wins, of course, and offers you a hand up. "Not yet," {he} says. "But soon."

choices.text: Laugh, and shake {his} hand

mem.note: laughed and shook my hand above the clouds

effects.log: You both laugh. Two old rivals in a sky full of strangers. It is good to see a face you know, even this one.

choices.text: Walk past and start training

effects.log: You walk past {npc} without a word and sit down to train. Behind you {he} laughs out loud. The race goes on.

choices.text: "I said I would catch you." Hold out your hand

mem.note: kept the vow shouted at the foot of the stairs

effects.log: {npc} looks at the hand, then at you, and takes it. "You did," {he} says. "Took you long enough." The race goes on, and it is better with two.

events.text: Among the immortals on the jade terraces is a face the whole world below once knew: {npc}, who went up the white stairs while you were still climbing towards them. {He} raises a cup to you. "Someone from home," {he} says.

choices.text: Drink with {him} and talk of the world below

mem.note: talked of home with me above the clouds

effects.log: You talk of the world below until the stars come out beneath your feet. {npc} wants to know everything that happened after {he} left.

choices.text: Ask {him} what to beware of up here

mem.note: asked my counsel in the Upper Realm

effects.log: {npc} names three immortals to avoid and one to trust. In the years to come you will be very glad of all four names.
